scriptLines: bronzeCircuits derive(circuitId = iif(isNull(circuitId) || trim(circuitId) == '' || upper(trim(circuitId)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(circuitId)) == 'N/A' || trim(circuitId) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(circuitId)),

circuitRef = iif(isNull(circuitRef) || trim(circuitRef) == '' || upper(trim(circuitRef)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(circuitRef)) == 'N/A' || trim(circuitRef) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(circuitRef)),
name = iif(isNull(name) || trim(name) == '' || upper(trim(name)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(name)) == 'N/A' || trim(name) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(name)),
location = iif(isNull(location) || trim(location) == '' || upper(trim(location)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(location)) == 'N/A' || trim(location) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(location)),
country = iif(isNull(country) || trim(country) == '' || upper(trim(country)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(country)) == 'N/A' || trim(country) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(country)),
lat = iif(isNull(lat) || trim(lat) == '' || upper(trim(lat)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(lat)) == 'N/A' || trim(lat) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(lat)),
lng = iif(isNull(lng) || trim(lng) == '' || upper(trim(lng)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(lng)) == 'N/A' || trim(lng) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(lng)),
alt = iif(isNull(alt) || trim(alt) == '' || upper(trim(alt)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(alt)) == 'N/A' || trim(alt) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(alt))) ~> limpiarTodo

limpiarTodo derive(paisTmp = case(upper(country) == 'USA', 'United States', upper(country) == 'UK', 'United Kingdom', upper(country) == 'UAE', 'United Arab Emirates', upper(country) == 'KOREA', 'South Korea', country)) ~> mapearPais
mapearPais derive(location = iif((location == lower(location) || location == upper(location)), replace(replace(initCap(lower(replace(location, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), ' De ', ' de '), location),
country = iif((paisTmp == lower(paisTmp) || paisTmp == upper(paisTmp)), replace(initCap(lower(replace(paisTmp, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), paisTmp)) ~> normalizarTextos
